Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender (2026)
MULTi AUDIO AND SUB
2160p AMZN WEB-DL DDP5.1 Atmos SDR H.265-MIXED

Director: Lauren Montgomery
Story: Tim Hedrick, Kenneth Lin, Michael Dante DiMartino, Bryan Konietzko
Screenplay: Tim Hedrick, Christopher L. Yost
Cast: Eric Nam, Dave Bautista, Jessica Matten, Román Zaragoza, Steven Yeun, Dionne Quan, Dee Bradley Baker
Genre: Animation, Action, Adventure, Fantasy
Release Date: July 25, 2026
Production: Paramount Pictures
Language: English + 19 additional dubs
Description:​
Avatar Aang, the world's last Airbender, learns of an ancient power that could save his culture from extinction. With the help of his friends, he embarks on a global quest to find it before it falls into the wrong hands and threatens to upend the peace they sacrificed everything to achieve.

item.title: 【Singles (lossless)】FLAC - Paula Abdul – 1990 Medley Mix LA Gear US Promo CD
item.description:
This is the LA Gear US Promo CD that was released in 1990. This version of the 1990 Medley Mix does not include "State Of Attraction", which is on the version released in the "Shut Up And Dance" Remix CD and it is only available on this promo CD.

Ripped from personal collection. Hope you enjoy it too!

Tracklist :

1990 Medley Mix (6:14)
1.1 Straight Up
1.2 Knocked Out
1.3 Opposites Attract
1.4 Forever Your Girl
1.5 The Way That You Love Me
1.6 Cold Hearted
